verdict.rationale: Galileo is an AI evaluation and observability platform, a kind of product that could plausibly ship a self-hosted deployment, so the axis applies. The evidence pack describes only the hosted service (cloud console, a production API at api.galileo.ai, SaaS pricing tiers) and never mentions self-hosting, on-prem, VPC, or open-source deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
